summary: STMicroelectronics N.V. filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the second quarter and six months ended June 27, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, presenting operating results, liquidity, and segment information. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change is disclosed. The report is submitted voluntarily under Rule 13a-16 and includes certifications under the Sarbanes-Oxley Act. No deal terms or strategic actions are mentioned, so this is not a special situation.
